title: Brand-New 7-Bedroom Dallas Showpiece with Space for Everyone

description:

The backyard is fully fenced. A premium workshop gives you immediate workspace, storage or room for hobbies, this 20x40 fully insulated shop is a tremendous bonus - featuring 10-foot ceilings, an 8-foot roll-up door, 220V power and a 10x40 covered porch and covered area for parking.

An oversized three-car garage with generator wiring and additional storage rounds out a property that delivers something increasingly difficult to find: a beautifully finished custom home paired with exceptional garage, shop and outdoor space.

Outside, the large two-story garage accommodates two vehicles while offering additional space above for storage, hobbies, or future possibilities. With nearly an acre of property, a private backyard, original details throughout, and convenient access to NYC and major commuter routes, this home offers a comfortable blend of space, character, and location.
